notes: Application-only image; SoftDevice S140 7.3.0 (FWID 0x0123) must already be flashed. Requires the Adafruit Feather UF2 bootloader.

versions.notes: Adafruit/Nordic DFU package. ST7789 240x240 SPI display (factory lcd_panel.cpp pinout), BLE advert name = MAC last 6 hex digits. Build env W13Meshnology_companion_radio_ble. Flash span 0x27000..0x97f1c, 113 pages, 451.8 KB application.
